title: El mes de la patria
desc: September, and the flags go up on everything
setting: Blue and white is on every pole and every bus. Roberto is painting a paper flag at your table.

steps.speaker: Roberto
steps.es: ¿En tu país también hacen esto en septiembre?
steps.en: Do they do this in your country in September too?

options.es: No así. Aquí se ve en todas partes.
options.en: Not like this. Here you see it everywhere.
options.feedback: An honest comparison with no verdict attached. He can carry that anywhere.
True, and it stops a conversation he opened to include you.
Said out loud in September that is not an opinion, it is an insult.

steps.speaker: Roberto
steps.es: Es que ganamos la independencia en septiembre.
steps.en: It is because we won independence in September.

options.es: ¿Y qué hacen en la escuela ese día?
options.en: And what do you do at school that day?
options.feedback: You turned his fact into his story. That is how a conversation stays open.
Polite, and it lands like a tourist. Ask him something.

options.en: I know that, I read it.
options.feedback: You have taken the story out of his mouth.

steps.speaker: Roberto
steps.es: Desfile. Todo el colegio, con tambores.
steps.en: A parade. The whole school, with drums.

options.es: ¿Vos vas a desfilar? Yo quiero ver eso.
options.en: Are you going to march? I want to see that.
options.feedback: You asked whether he is in it and said you want to see it. That is an acceptance before the invitation.
Warm enough. You have still not said you will come.
They are, and it is his parade. Keep that one to yourself.

steps.speaker: Roberto
steps.es: Vení pues. Es a las ocho, en la calle grande.
steps.en: Come then. It is at eight, on the main street.

options.es: Ahí nos vemos. No me lo pierdo.
options.en: See you there. I will not miss it.
options.feedback: A time, a place, and a promise. That is how an invitation is answered here.
Trying is what people say when they mean no. He will hear it that way.
That is the polite no, and he will understand it perfectly.
